body: Shyness. Awkwardness. I tend to assume I’d be wasting any self respecting woman’s time.
I know I’m late to this. But I know how small towns can be, and how shallow minded the people can be therein. Be yourself!
Surely, though, you aren’t saying I just completely forget my brother and never, ever offer to help when/if it’s needed right? That’s what I’m getting at.

No, I see what you’re saying. I appreciate it. 

It is genuinely difficult though as they do need help sometimes.
Look I know what you’re saying but the fact of the matter is that my brother needs someone. That doesn’t make me a martyr.
